name: game-builder
description: game-builder — the agentic-first pipeline for making games in Godot 4, modelled on the Sailes app-builder. BUILD: game-start → game-discovery (concept + scope ladder) → game-bootstrap (Godot project + methodology, generated by gb scaffold) → spec → phased implementation, every phase a playable build verified by the engine (gb verify) and played by the human.
